import.title: Import Transactions from CSV
import.mapColumnsHelp: Map your CSV columns to transaction fields. All fields are required for proper import.
import.invalidColumnsWarning: Some selected columns don't exist in your CSV. Please reselect the correct columns from the dropdown.
import.uniqueIdHelp: Optional: Additional field to include in duplicate detection hash (e.g., transaction reference number)
import.detectTypes: Detect transfers between your accounts, refunds and type-rule matches
import.selectAccountColumnHint: Select an "Account Number Column" from your CSV, or choose an account directly if all transactions belong to one account.
import.directAccountNotice: All transactions will be imported to: {{account}}
import.mapAccountsTitle: Map CSV Account Numbers to Your Accounts
import.mapAccountsHelp: Select which of your accounts corresponds to each account number found in the CSV, create the account if it is not in the app yet, or skip it.

transferReview.title: Detected Transfers
transferReview.help: Each row pairs money leaving one account with the same amount arriving in another. Checked pairs are imported as transfers (counted as neither income nor spending); uncheck a pair to import both rows as ordinary expense / income instead. Hover the confidence for the evidence.

duplicatesResolver.title: Resolve Internal Duplicates
duplicatesResolver.found_one: Found {{count}} set of duplicate transactions within your CSV. Select which records to include in the import.
duplicatesResolver.found_other: Found {{count}} sets of duplicate transactions within your CSV. Select which records to include in the import.
duplicatesResolver.howItWorks: How duplicate resolution works: When you select multiple transactions from the same set, each will receive a unique variation seed. The first selected transaction keeps the original hash (seed 0), while subsequent selections get incrementing seeds (1, 2, etc.). This allows you to import legitimate duplicates while preventing re-imports of the same CSV file.
duplicatesResolver.includeAllHelp: Import every record in every set as its own transaction, for repeat purchases that are genuinely separate (e.g. two museum tickets bought on one day). Turn off to choose records individually.
